violations.why: Only walnut is enabled after line 38; it can preempt main between the check and the reset and its increment is overwritten.
After walnut enables ISR 2, dune can preempt main between the check and the reset and its increment is overwritten.
On a later walnut run ISR 2 is already enabled, so dune can preempt the walnut increment between its read and write and the update is lost.
